description: Confirmed release blockers and their current disposition (#759). Changes only through reviewed PRs to main; see docs/HOSTING.md. Resolved history stays in the linked issues and PRs, so resolved entries may be pruned.

blockers.title: Damaged legacy save records can leave a blank app before startup migrations finish
affectedRevisions: Affected code already present at 5676f12 (#535), so not a regression from a recent change
blockers.scenario: A stored brainrot-stats-v1 record with a null best-pack card and no data-version marker throws in runMigrations before React mounts; #root stays empty on every reload and no recovery or export UI is reachable.
blockers.severityRationale: Persistent startup blank screen for an affected browser profile, with no in-app way to recover the save.
blockers.requiredEvidence: a merged fix with a regression test that seeds the damaged legacy record and asserts startup reaches a usable or recovery screen, passing on the final candidate

blockers.title: Startup does work proportional to a restored ticket counter rather than recorded data
affectedRevisions: Unbounded iteration confirmed by an offline probe at main 2bf60747956397ba0fec07dda4f093d64691beed
Affected code already present at 5676f12 (#535), so not a regression from a recent change
blockers.scenario: A small supported save with a very large nextNonce is accepted by importSaveFile; the opening screen's stats iterate every ticket number up to that counter. Bounded probes at 100,000 and 1,000,000 materialized all missing tickets; the extreme-counter browser hang or crash was not executed.
blockers.severityRationale: If the extreme case hangs startup it is a persistent blank or unusable opening screen; the unbounded work is confirmed but that outcome is not yet reproduced, so it stays fail-closed until fixed or reclassified on evidence.
blockers.requiredEvidence: a merged fix with a regression test showing startup work is bounded by recorded data for a sparse, very large counter, passing on the final candidate

blockers.title: A pending Replace import bypasses the stale-save guard
affectedRevisions: Reproduced with two same-origin tabs at main 2bf60747956397ba0fec07dda4f093d64691beed
Affected code already present at 5676f12 (#535), so not a regression from a recent change
blockers.scenario: Tab A reviews a replacement of save Original; tab B replaces the save with Switched; tab A's still-pending Replace then imports over Switched despite the stale-tab warning, without approval for replacing Switched.
blockers.severityRationale: A stale review authorizes overwriting a different, newer current save; the import backup holds the overwritten save, so permanent deletion or identity mixing was not demonstrated.
blockers.requiredEvidence: a merged fix with a regression test that changes the save in another tab and asserts the pending Replace is refused, passing on the final candidate
